review_description: I wanted to extend my heartfelt thanks to Jeff, Micheal, Harris , Jessie and rest of Lynton Electrical team for the outstanding work they did in installing the new circuit for the solar water booster and new solar system at my place. They professionalism, attention to detail, and expertise were evident throughout the entire process, and I am thoroughly impressed with the results!Living first half of my life in manufacturing powerhouse. I truly appreciate the initiative to reducing carbon emission and maintaining a clean environment is invaluable for out health and well-being.It was a pleasure working with such a dedicated team. Their efforts have significantly contributed to the sustainability of my home.Looking ahead, I am very interested in exploring the installation of a battery system when my budget is permitted in next few months and would love to engage with them again for the project!

The guys at Lynton Electrical did a great job. Michael was the lead, and was very easy to communicate with. He explained the process and how everything worked. They were diligent and meticulous with their work. There were a few software problems at the beginning, but they were sorted out with no fuss.Highly recommend the team.
Overall they explained the options and gave a competitive quote. Then did a great job, all on time and no surprises

They were very helpful and patient during the sales process as I did a lot of research and had many questions.The installation went extremely well, they had a good team that explained what they were doing when asked. They cleaned up and have initiated the formal part of the grid connection.We are using the SolarEdge app which we are finding very helpful.

The boys from Lynton did a great job, and kept us informed the whole way. They were the only ones of the three quotes who actually visited the site and went up on the roof to ensure the proposed setup was appropriate and took our requests into considerationVery happy with the job, and exciting to see generation of our own energy.
